_comment: Which reply leads to which line. The one thing about an NPC the client has never held.
The client ships every line an NPC can say and every reply it can be given, and nowhere does
it say which goes with which - measured across all 6,467 of them. That pairing has always
lived on Ankama's server, so it cannot be extracted or measured. It has to be decided, and
this is where the decision goes.
npc         the NPC's id
map         0 for wherever it stands; a map id to say something different there
opening     which line it starts on; the first one when left out
lines       one per thing it says, each with what can be said back
next        the line that reply leads to; left out, the conversation ends
And what a reply is FOR, which is what stops a conversation offering everything at once:
startsQuest  this reply hands that quest over. Not the same as `quest`: this one is how a
quest begins, so it is offered to somebody who has NOT got it.
quest        only offered while that quest is under way.
step         and only while it is on that step.
afterQuest   only offered once the quest is finished.
Where the conversation opens, when it is not always the same line:
openings     tried in order, the first that holds wins; none, and `opening`. Each has a
`message` or a `byBreed` table (breed id to message) and any of: `before`
(quest neither started nor finished), `quest` (under way), `step` (and on that
step), `objective` (and that objective done), `after` (quest finished),
`criterion` (the character meets it, in the client's language: «Ps=0»).
pushes       a line the NPC opens by itself, with no click, once a step of a quest ends:
`afterStep` and a `message` or `byBreed`. The tutorial's voice does it.
params       what a reply shows beside it, as effects: a number, or an array whose first
number is the effect and the rest what it names, [34, 2511] for «starts quest
{ "npc": 1088, "map": 0, "opening": 3312, "lines": [
{ "message": 6047, "choices": [ { "reply": 7846 } ] } ] }
A line with no replies is fine now: the client draws its own Leave button and the X closes the
window, because the server answers the kla it sends. It did not before, which is why an NPC
with nothing to say back used to trap you in the conversation.
WHERE THESE COME FROM. The ids are the client's own. The wiring - which reply leads where -
is read off the walkthroughs at dofuspourlesnoobs, which write the reply options out in
French, and matched back to ids with tools/dialogue_from_guide.py. Inside one NPC the text
identifies its lines 98.3% of the time, and the reply ids do not have to be Ankama's: the
server sends the ids and the client sends back what it was given, so any id with the right
text works as long as the tree agrees with itself.
mutation      the reply gives this mutation item after its teleport (the Orbalantir's).
endsMutation  the reply takes the player's mutation away after its teleport.
givesAlteration  the reply puts this alteration on the player (Max Ymillán's «Supercaptura»).
teaches       the reply teaches this spell for good (the Sadida priestess's Nécronyx).
alsoLeaves    other NPCs of the map who go with the one spoken to (the dummy that was Riberico).

Anta Brok, from her own lines and replies, by «La galette secrète» of Dofus pour les noobs. Asked for work (25216), she asks whether the character can cook (20975) and tells of the dessert her sister dared her to make (20976, the line the catalogue names); «Yo puedo hacer la torta por ti.» hands the quest over with the secret recipe (16517), whose reading is 9805. The cake shown (25218) does 9807 and sends the character to Kotorra for jam (20978); cake and jam handed over (25224) do 9810, and Anta tastes the jam (20979): «Probar la mermelada» or not, and she keeps the cake (20981, 20982). «El fin del reinado»: «Te cambio tu cuerda de viña por algo.» (20989: the souls newly incarnated tied it round their waist), «Hacer el intercambio.» takes the chimeric plume of a tofu (5247) and gives the vine rope («échangez votre plume contre une ficelle»). «El fin del reinado»: «Te cambio tu cuerda de viña por algo.» (20989: the souls newly incarnated tied it round their waist), «Hacer el intercambio.» takes the chimeric plume of a tofu (5247) and gives the vine rope («échangez votre plume contre une ficelle»). «El fin del reinado»: «Te cambio tu cuerda de viña por algo.» (20989: the souls newly incarnated tied it round their waist), «Hacer el intercambio.» takes the chimeric plume of a tofu (5247) and gives the vine rope («échangez votre plume contre une ficelle»).

Marylork the painter, from his own lines and replies, by «Un peu de pigment» of Dofus pour les noobs: asked about himself he is out of green paint (21197), «Yo puedo ayudarte.» hands the quest over and he asks for aminite powder from the mines (21198); «Toma el polvo de amenita.» hands over the three powders (9970) and he thanks the character (21199).

Noken Okuto (Lykhen Lesurviven), at the village gate, from his own lines and replies. «Le village dans les nuages» per Dofus pour les noobs: he takes the character for a newcomer and sends him back to Master Joris (20776, a line from before 3.6), «Répondre que vous préférez apprendre par vous-même» (24896) and «Demander où trouver Ternette» (24893), whose answer, 20779, says her place is already marked in the quest journal. The catalogue hands the quest over on 20780 «¿Qué tenemos aquí? Otra alma aventurera...», on «¿Quién es Ternauta?»; 20777 is the same offer on the way Dofus pour les noobs describes, and hands it over on its own «¿Quién es Ternauta?». «Espoirs et tragédies»: he tells of his exploits and of the six dofus he nearly had, then laughs at the apocalypse story; 24909 leads to his farewell and is the veteran's objective (objectives.json). Who stares back (24911) hears the truth; who apologises (24907) or insults him (24913) is sent off.

Berbe Unin, from his own lines and replies, by Dofus pour les noobs («Produits naturels», «La hache et la pioche», «Boune un jour, boune toujours») and the catalogue's lines for each quest (21043, 57160, 21050, 21056, 57184). His trials go in pairs of chains: one said on the way back from the previous one («Ya he terminado.» then «Mira lo que he confeccionado/fabricado.») and one for another day («Estoy listo para otro trabajo.», «Ya puedo hacer otra tarea.»). 3.6 put «El oficio de los aventureros» (the meat broth, with his hunting knife, 30832) between the first two and «Preparación para el combate» after the Bun set; its last objective, seeing him again, is «Mira lo que he fabricado.» (19270), and the title of son of Incarnam (21068). The pieces of «El oficio de los aventureros», «A pico y hacha», «Bun empieza lo que Bun acaba» and «Preparación para el combate» are shown with the reply that shows them, not on hello, so the talk goes on to the next quest.

Ternette, the mayor, from her own lines and replies in the client, paired by what they say and by Dofus pour les noobs. Her replies come in pairs of chains: one said on the way (back from the previous errand: «He hablado con Xelora», «He conseguido encontrar cinco vestigios») and one for another day («Cuéntame más cosas sobre los dioses», «Háblame del Mundo de los Doce»); the catalogue names the second chain's line for each quest (20808, 20814, 20819). «Transporte único» is also offered from the welcome of «Un pueblo sobre las nubes», «Estoy impaciente por explorar la isla celeste» next to «Daré una vuelta por el pueblo», which is where Dofus pour les noobs has it.

dialogues._source: written from the NPC's own conversation in the client; see tools/npc_conversation.py
dialogues.why: Klasmor the gravedigger, keeper of Chadalid's crypt. «Dans la gueule du Milimilou»: asked about the Minilubo (24989), he would rather the character faced flesh than the walking dead (20839), tells where the beast lives (20840) and the two ways in, past Chadalid or by the rusty grate to the west (20841, the line 9784 names). «Cryptologie» is handed over on his opening (20830, the line the catalogue names) by going into the crypt, with the bunch of keys (24973) or a key (24970); the door itself is DungeonHandler's. The same two go in again without the quest while it is under way and once it is done: a reply that starts a quest is only offered while it can be started, and Klasmor offered nothing but «S'en aller» to whoever had been in once.

dialogues._source: written from the NPC's own conversation in the client; see tools/npc_conversation.py

dialogues.why: Dani Tanor (Didier Jean in French), one of the three claiming Astrub's pond, by «Ça tombe à l'eau» of Dofus pour les noobs: the trouble with the mercenaries (13953, 30886, 30887) and, sent to talk to them, «Charlar con los mercenarios»; turned to after the mercenary's threat (77921), his deeds, the plan and the notary Fer Liz (57258-57261, 13955: the client's later lines for that talk, which replace 30900-30902); and, back from Archi, «Explicarle el problema y sugerirle que vaya a hablar con la consejera Archi» (13957), and the notary's description (30906).

The angry mercenary at the pond («Ça tombe à l'eau», «Sur la même map, parlez au Mercenaire agacé»): the three individuals (30895), «Voy a tratar de solucionar el problema con calma.» (13954), and if that fails they will be put out by force (30896); «Volverte hacia Dani Tanor» (the client's later reply for it).

Camilo Demolinos (Camille Démouleur), the false duke's servant, at the market [4,-17], by «Ça tombe à l'eau»: questioned, he has to wait his turn with the rascals bothering him (30911, «Encargarte de los canallas», 13959); after the fight his thanks (30915), how he came into the duke's service (30916, 30917), his work for him (30918) and the bankers (30919, 13961).

«¡Huele a podrido en el reino de Amakna!» (Quelque chose de pourri au royaume d'Amakna, Dofus pour les noobs) (1424): «*Enseñarle el sello de Fallanster* ¿Puedo entrar en la sala de la asamblea?» (19364) with the seal is «Muestra el sello» (7914, the seal kept) and takes the character into the assembly hall (115082755); «Quiero volver a la sala de la asamblea.» (19365) takes him back while the quest lasts.
The Bontarian militiawoman, recruiting in Astrub: her call to join (3030, 3031); by «Les deux font l'impair», her city's militia presented while the quest has her to see (30425-30430, 13793).
The Brakmarian militiawoman, recruiting in Astrub: her call to join (3027, 3028); by «Les deux font l'impair», her city's militia presented while the quest has her to see (30431-30436, 13794).

The guided tutorial's Mysterious Voice, as the capture of the whole tutorial has it: 60352 «¿Estás bien?» with «Desplazarte.» (effect 2192), which starts 2545; the first steps walked (idz 3226) and the voice opens by itself on the god of the character's class, then «Basta de cháchara» and «Ver cómo se materializa un camino» (2192 twice), and the window closes. The god's line, its reply and the next line are the class's own, in breed order. Whoever lingers gets the four lines that tell them to go, each answered by the next of its four replies. The capture's stagings (Managers.MapStagings): 902 on «Desplazarte.», 912 and 302 around the line on the god once the steps are walked, 901 and 102 on «Ver cómo se materializa un camino», the path off the island.

Ganymed on the celestial puch's platform, as the tutorial capture has him: 57134 «Te doy la bienvenida a Incarnam» with «Dirigirte hacia el puch celestial para atacarlo» (2192, 192) while 2545 waits on him; back from the first fight (2502 on 3169) 57133 «¡Bravo! He metido algunos objetos en tu bolsa» with «Buscar en tu bolsa los objetos y equipártelos», six 193 for the six items and 34 «Empieza una misión» naming 2511. Before that fight, his «¡Adelante, sin miedo!»; with 2511 under way, «Con tu nuevo equipo...»; afterwards, the puch is there to train on. Greeting him does 3169's objective and hands the six items over first, so 57133 is also his line on 3170 while 2511 has not started: the hello no longer skips «Primeras armas». «Dirigirte hacia el puch celestial para atacarlo» is what ends 2545 (19535), as the capture has it (lqn 56 after the reply), so the hello does not skip his welcome.

Ganymed by the jalatós' pen, as the tutorial capture has him: after the fight (2502 on 3173) 57132 «Tus oponentes han mordido el polvo» with «Dar saltitos de impaciencia» (30 naming objective 19173, then 1142); the characteristic points still to share out (3184), the line on which element each characteristic masters; then 60411 «¿Has elegido tu vía?» with «Quedarte para entrenar» and «Unirte al maestro Curro», both showing 2192 and 34 for quest 1629, the second starting it.

Master Curro in the tutorial's jobs room, as the capture of the whole tutorial has him: 20676 «¡Saludos, joven!» with «¿Cómo va eso?», then 20677 with «¿Qué materiales me van a hacer falta?» (30 naming objective 9656 and eight 1150), then 20678 with «Explorar el lugar.» (five 1150 and 2192); once the ring is made, 20681 «¡Has trabajado muy bien, #1!», his name in it, with «Dirigirte a la salida.» showing quest 1630 and starting it. In between, the reminder of what the ring needs; afterwards, his «No hay nada como la satisfacción...».

The celestial chafer pikemen of the combat room, as the tutorial capture has them: 20706 «llama a los chafers al rescate» with «Empezar el combate contra los tres monstruos» (911, the fight of content/fights/npc_fights.json, once Master Darmas has been heard) and «Retirarte»; once beaten, «juega con su lanza».
The celestial chafer explorer of the combat room: the same fight from his «llama a los chafers como apoyo», and «se prepara para la revancha» once beaten.

Master Darmas in the combat room, as the tutorial capture has him: 20700 «Eres #1, ¿verdad?», the name in it, with «Estoy dispuesto a demostrar lo que valgo.», then 20744 with «Seguir escuchando.» (30 naming objective 9685), then 57155 with «Dirigirte hacia una criatura para provocarla.»; after the chafers, 21200 «¡Has ganado!» with «Sobresaltarte al ver aparecer a Ganymed» (350, 3007), on which Ganymed comes in (jsn, actor -20004) and speaks.

Ganymed coming into the combat room after the chafers, as the tutorial capture has him: 57149 «¡Bravo, #1!», 57220 on changing class while a novice, 57221 «Antes de que abandones el templo...» with «Seguir a Ganymed» (31 naming step 2250, 777), which takes the player to the Dofusarium (jru 241443329).

Ganymed in the Dofusarium. The tutorial capture ends on his 57150 «Aquel que quiere ver cumplido su destino...» with «Inspeccionar las seis estatuas de dofus» (34 naming 1631, then 3010), the reply that starts 1631. The rest is his own lines in the order Dofus pour les noobs gives the quest: once the statues are read, 60427 on the Dofus and the hint to the book (60428, «Consultar el libro del templo», «Ir a la próxima sala»); once the book is read, 57151 «Ha llegado el momento de que comiences tu gran viaje» with «Dirigirte a la salida del Templo Celeste»; afterwards, his farewell 57154 with the name. «Dirigirte a la salida del Templo Celeste» is what completes 9740 and ends the quest, so the hello does not skip the line.

Azar (Aléha), the Ecaflip of the tavern, from her own lines and replies. Her four «Lanzar los dados sobre la mesa.» on each of the two dice lines (20935 after her story, 20940 when asked straight away) are one throw: one is offered, at random, and each leads to its own result (20936-20939, 20941-20944) with its own farewell. Dofus pour les noobs: she came back to Incarnam, tells of the guardians of the dofus and has the character throw her dice.

Oscar Kasa (Oskar Khas), the thief's ghost of the phoenix rock, from his own lines and replies. «Espoirs et tragédies» per Dofus pour les noobs: asked what happened to him, he tells of the Emerald dofus he died for, smells something burning, and the evil fire that haunts him comes back; «Quedarte y luchar contra el fuego maléfico» starts the fight (npc_fights.json). The rest is his talk on death and the phoenix. «Examen de paso» (1906): told you mean to cross Erazal's wound into Externam (34469), he says a living soul cannot, tells the boatmen's tale of the death masks and sends you to someone who could make one (28742-28745); «Le remercier et suivre son conseil» (34465) is 13027. Dofus pour les noobs: «Dire que vous avez l'intention de franchir la Blessure d'Erazal pour entrer en Externam».

The Minilubo Albino in his lair: «Atacar al monstruo» starts the fight (npc_fights.json), «Huir de la cripta» leads back out through the grate (teleports.json). The jam pot of «La torta secreta» has its own lines (20850-20852) for whoever carries it, not written yet.

Likantrabioso (Hargnok), once the Minilubo is beaten: he was the beast, bitten by it before he killed it, and his dofus are long gone (Dofus pour les noobs, «Dans la gueule du Milimilou»). «Salir de la Cripta del Minilubo Albino» leads back out through the grate. He stands there for whoever has not the quest too (spawns.json), and to him «¿Dónde está el Minilubo?» is only a question: its objective (9786) and its «?» go with the quest under way.

Master Anemó, keeper of the portal to Astrub, from his own lines and replies: whether the character wants to leave Incarnam (30374), whether the island is explored (30375, 30376), and what is past the portal, the heart of Astrub and the envoy of the gods (30377). «Destino Astrub» asks to see him (13767, done on talking to him).

Xelora Pañá, who mends the zaaps with her hammer, from her own lines and replies: where the zaaps come from (20857), how a hammer mends them (20858, 20859), the zaap's use (20860), and «Examinar el zaap justo al lado.», which is «Transporte único»'s 9815 (objectives.json).

Masvisto and his astromagic telescope, from his own lines and replies. «Me envía Ternauta.» while «Vistas celestes» wants his telescope: he asks after her (20823) and lets the character to the eyepiece (20824). Anyone else may ask for a look (20822).

Galilea and her telescope, from her own lines and replies. «Me envía Ternauta.» while «Vistas celestes» wants her telescope: the Unin family helped her build it (20828); anyone else may ask to use it (20827).

The Rata Nsiosa of the tavern's cellar, out of the tap once the lemonade has been poured (jsn of template 2912 on cell 385, facing 5, right after ieb 9769 in «mision matarratas completa»). Its only line, 20872, and «Atacar a la rata.» with effect 905, which starts the fight on 153486338 (npc_fights.json).

Kotorra (Pipelette), in the library, from her own lines and replies. «¿Tienes por ahí un tarro de mermelada para mí?» while «La torta secreta» sends the character to her (9808): her jam for nettles (20985). «Aquí tienes algunas ortigas.» hands over the five nettles (9809) and, once they are taken, her home-made jam (16509, 20986).

Chadalid (Kardorim), in the room past his own, from his own lines and replies. «Cryptologie» per Dofus pour les noobs: «demandez à Kardorim qui il est» -- «Háblame de ti.» (24993) is the visit, 9813 --; once captain of the celestial militia, raised by the graveyard's curse (20843), he tries to discipline the chafers (20844). Asked about the Minilubo (24991, 24999), he offers the way to its lair (24990, 24996, 25015, passages in teleports.json); his «Salir de la Cripta de Chadalid» replies leave the dungeon (dungeon_exits.json).

Corporal Mienerva, from her own lines and replies, by «Mise à l'épreuve» of Dofus pour les noobs: «Estoy listo para pasar el test de aptitud.» (the visit, 9828), her doubts (20906), «Protestar e insistir» and the fight (20907, «Empezar el combate.», npc_fights.json); beaten, «¿Ha sido concluyente el test?» (20909) and «Voy a ver al capitán» (9830). Who lost may try again (25093, 20908).

Kruella Troz, the vain Osamodas of «Leçon d'humilité» (Dofus pour les noobs: «Kruella vous menace de vous fouetter... Défiez alors la fougueuse Osamodas»): while the mission is on, her threat (20900) and «Desafiarla en combate uno contra uno.» (npc_fights.json); beaten, she let the character win (20901); otherwise her vanity (20903, 20902).

Percy Klópeo, the one-eyed chafer of «Des chafers qui marchent», who comes out when his tomb is searched: «Defenderte.» starts the fight (npc_fights.json), and beating him drops the jewel bag (16540, 100 % in his drops).

Tek Abir, the tavern keeper of Astrub, from his own lines and replies. «On marche sur des œufs» per Dofus pour les noobs: «Commander une bière» for 40 kamas (30385, «Son 40 kamas y aquí no se fía.»), the Cerveza de Astrub; asked about the dofus, the rumour of pandawas (30645, 30646). «Ça tombe à l'eau»: the notary's description without naming him (13958): the Duke of Sidimote, gone, but his servant Camilo Demolinos is still around (30907-30909), at the markets. «Bière qui roule n'amasse pas mousse»: «Pedir una cerveza para Bajofrente», «Aquí tienes los 40 kamas.» (« Payer les 40 kamas », 13769) for the frothy Astrub beer (19623), and hurry before the froth goes (30386). The same reply buys the ordinary beer for anybody else: the quest's comes first in the line. «Trempette dans un verre d'eau»: Essel Dawa's Pandatriple from his private stock (31623: 14215, item 19765).

Acidrik Rasgapanza, the haruspex of the tavern, from his own lines and replies: «Busco los dofus.» (Dofus pour les noobs: «Dire que vous êtes à la recherche des Dofus»), a beer for the stars (30666), and «Darle una cerveza a Acidrik.», which takes the Cerveza de Astrub and has him dance with the stars (30667-30669). «Attention à la Bête !»: investigating the beast (36998), a cold beer to see where it hides (30648), the beer given (4661) and what its foam shows (30649), no more details (30650). «Attention à la Bête !»: investigating the beast (36998), a cold beer to see where it hides (30648), the beer given (4661) and what its foam shows (30649), no more details (30650). «Attention à la Bête !»: investigating the beast (36998), a cold beer to see where it hides (30648), the beer given (4661) and what its foam shows (30649), no more details (30650). «Attention à la Bête !»: investigating the beast (36998), a cold beer to see where it hides (30648), the beer given (4661) and what its foam shows (30649), no more details (30650).

Sus Belli (Huze Belli), drinking upstairs at the tavern, from her own lines and replies. «On marche sur des œufs» per Dofus pour les noobs: told the character seeks the dofus and can pay («Prétendre que vous avez hérité d'un joli magot de la part de votre tatie»), she sends him to Nowa with the password (30684); that is «Habla con los ocupantes de la taberna para atraer la atención de un traficante» (13852).

Nowa, the pandawa who sells false dofus, from his own lines and replies, by «On marche sur des œufs» of Dofus pour les noobs: the password «La tortilla ya está lista para servirse.» (the visit, 13853), ten thousand kamas for a shining egg (30690, 30691), the threat with the weapon (37054), his ten-kama bribe and «Soy incorruptible.» (30693), and he runs: the fight (npc_fights.json). Beaten, he gives himself up (30687) and «Escoltar al pandawa hasta el jefe de la milicia»; still standing, «¿Otra vez tú?» (30688); afterwards, his trafficking days are over (30686).

The mercenary instructress of the militia's second room, from her own lines and replies, by «C'est pour ta pomme» of Dofus pour les noobs: sent by Setsinbol (14157), out of apples (31508) and off to the grocer's (31509); the rotten apples handed over (14164) make her angry and send the character to the market (31510); the apples saved from the thieves (14173) and she lets him train (31511), on the trunk in the middle of the room.

«C'est pour ta pomme»: no fresh apples, they were stolen (31512); a crate of rotten ones instead (31513, 19750), the ones he keeps for Tek Abir (31514). «Bûcherons en détresse»: honey wanted (37859), a fresh batch from Bonta's fields with no price on it yet and a joke (31343), a forced laugh for a discount and a hundred kamas all the same (31344): paid and taken (14087), or off to beg by the zaap. «Zobal Hibaba et les 40 Roublards»: 2000 litres of used frying oil, paid in advance with Hibabá's bag (8770: 4641).

«C'est pour ta pomme»: his crates of apples stolen, and a basket of tomatoes with them (31516); a free crate for whoever brings them back (31517), «Seguir el rastro de tomates.» (14166). His talk about trade (30565-30567). «Livraison par intérim»: Estefi Dora's three crates (13834, offered once carried), at her usual rates (30564). «La fête de la chocopépite»: the drinks renegotiated by a tantrum, beaten dog, flailing, crying, crescendo (31089-31092), 15% and the guard threatened (31093: 14017), twenty years and nobody had done that (31094). «La fête de la chocopépite»: the drinks renegotiated by a tantrum, beaten dog, flailing, crying, crescendo (31089-31092), 15% and the guard threatened (31093: 14017), twenty years and nobody had done that (31094).
A tomato thief at [2,-17], knocked out (31518): asked for the crates, they were stolen from her too (31519, 14167); «Llamar a un mercenario para que las conduzca a la celda.»

The Astrub mercenary at [2,-17]: told where the thieves are (14168), he takes them in charge (31522), and the character follows the trail to the meadow («Voy a seguir el rastro de tomates en la pradera de nuevo.»).

The apple thieves loading the stolen crates near the sewer's entrance, from their own lines and replies, by Dofus pour les noobs («Flanquer une correction aux voleurs»): seen loading the crates (14170), told to go back to Astrub (31524) or mocked (31525), and the fight against three of them (npc_fights.json).

Fallanster, head of the Council of Astrub, in the council chamber upstairs (Dofus pour les noobs: «Empruntez donc les escaliers situés derrière Archie»). «Ça sent le gaz»: his welcome (30710), a neutral envoy for the Strubian rats (30957), the toxic fumes in the mines (30959), and «Estoy dispuesto a parlamentar con el jefe de las ratas.» (13901, 30960). Back with Rathrosk: «Te presento a Rathrosk.» (13943) shows him a squirrel (30961), «pedirle que se transforme» (13944) a dragon (30953); the summary (30954), the legend (30955) and Aisling at the library (30956). «Balade en forêt»: «Hablarle de la emboscada de los pandikazes» (13950); the support of the daimyo Hikomi (31066), the sacred place on Pandala (31067), the sealed message (31068, 31069, the line «Le réceptacle des Dofus» names). Put off for later, «Mencionar un viaje a la isla de Pandala» takes it up again (31075). «¡Huele a podrido en el reino de Amakna!» (Quelque chose de pourri au royaume d'Amakna, Dofus pour les noobs) (1424), once the six signers are questioned and «Paseo por el bosque» (1962) is over («Pour continuer la quête, vous devez avoir terminé la quête Balade en forêt»): «¿Qué puedes contarme del edicto de Vhelika?» (37082) gets why Astrub refused (30711), «¿Qué sabes sobre el debate entre los dirigentes?» (37081) the speakers reciting like actors and the symbols (30712), «¿Puedes describir esos símbolos?» (37080) a sun or an eye (30713), «Pues podría ser el caso.» (37079) is 7913 and hands his seal (14571) for Hal Ylanza (30714), «Gracias. Hasta luego.» (37078).
The hungry rats of the sewers, after the cheese: «Este regalo es para vuestro jefe.» and they would take it anyway (30965); the fight against three of them (npc_fights.json), «Ça sent le gaz».

Ramán Hitu, chief of the Strubian rats, from his own lines and replies, by «Ça sent le gaz»: once his rats are beaten, his apologies (30967); the crate from Fallanster (13935, taken), the rats' innocence (30969, 30970), the grey hairs on an old grate (30971), móguiz hair (30972), and the quarry mine to explore (30973). «De vrais rats de bibliothèque»: back after beating three of his library rats (31236), the stolen document (14007): rats steal everything (31237), but he owes the character for the móguices' quarry (31238) and gives the tooled leather case back (19690); back to the surface (31239).

Back with all seven checked (18390-18397), he suspects his assistant Dante (18398); with Dante freed, «résumez lui toute la situation» ends it (18405). Raty Opatio, the gossip of Brakmar's sewers [-24,38]: Dofus pour les noobs, «Fait comme un rat», «interroger Norat Go au sujet d'un certain Stanis Ast», who saw the Black Rat drag a Brakmarian into her Moumousetrap. Asking about Dante does «Investiga la desaparición de Dante Hallu» (18399).

Dante Hallu, Dexter's assistant, behind bars in the Third Room of the Black Rat's Moumousetrap: Dofus pour les noobs, «Fait comme un rat», «parlez à Stanis Ast enfermé derrière des barreaux qui jure être innocent»; promising to bring the Black Rat round does «Encuentra a Dante Hallu en la Raratonera» (18400).

The Black Rat in her Moumousetrap's last room, once beaten (18401): Dofus pour les noobs, «Fait comme un rat», «Lui parler de Stanis et demander sa libération», she frees him only for a strong Brakmarian to play with (18403); «Lui présenter la brâkmarienne» hands the militiawoman over (18404, the follower item 26166) and sends you out. «Salir de la Raratonera» takes you back to her door [-28,37].

The bored militiawoman of Brakmar [-28,33]: Dofus pour les noobs, «Fait comme un rat», «Proposer lui donc de consacrer son temps au divertissement du Rat Noir», and she asks for a duel to warm up (content/fights/npc_fights.json, «il s'effectue seul»). Beaten, she follows you: her own loot is the follower 26166, with the client's criterion «Qo>18403&Qo<18404&PO!26166».
The militiawoman once handed over, in the Black Rat's last room: «Desde que estoy aquí, la vida es completamente diferente... la Rata Negra es bastante entrañable».

Rata Plan at the Moumousetrap's door [-28,37]: besides the key and the keyring (DungeonDoor), Dofus pour les noobs, «Fait comme un rat», «parlez à Rat Pido pour « Se rendre auprès du Rat Noir en compagnie de la brâkmarienne »», straight to her room. «No.» closes it.

Pyer Matiz, the collector of the cosmetics market of Bonta [-35,-60], who gives «Le pacte des profondeurs» (2433): Dofus pour les noobs, «Le pacte des profondeurs», his men sent into the sewers for garriglifos are not coming back. «Resumirle los hechos» ends it (18456). Which reply leads to which line is read off their texts.

A garriglifo, the rock carving Pyer is after: Dofus pour les noobs, «Le pacte des profondeurs», «dès l'entrée sur la map [-31,-57] des égouts parlez à la Calligriffes sur le mur», with signs of a struggle and no fight. Its three «Inspeccionar los alrededores» are one per search zone, in the objectives' order.

A garriglifo, the rock carving Pyer is after: Dofus pour les noobs, «Le pacte des profondeurs», «descendez les égouts jusqu'en [-31,-55] et parlez à la Calligriffes sur le pilier»: rats attack (content/fights/npc_fights.json). Its three «Inspeccionar los alrededores» are one per search zone, in the objectives' order.

A garriglifo, the rock carving Pyer is after: Dofus pour les noobs, «Le pacte des profondeurs», «allez sur la gauche jusqu'en [-33,-54] pour inspecter une troisième Calligriphes sur le pilier à droite de la pièce», and the rats attack again. Its three «Inspeccionar los alrededores» are one per search zone, in the objectives' order.

The White Rat's envoy at the third search zone [-33,-54]: Dofus pour les noobs, «Le pacte des profondeurs», «Une fois le combat terminé, parlez à l'Envoyée du Rat Blanc», who blames the surface for breaking the pact of the depths signed with the intendant (18449).

Danathor, Bonta's intendant, in the palace room right of the throne room [-36,-60]: Dofus pour les noobs, «Le pacte des profondeurs», he signed the pact of the depths and sends you to Captain Tymo for presents (18450); after Tymo's ambush, «Mencionar la emboscada» and he blames Tymo alone (18455). «¡Huele a podrido en el reino de Amakna!» (Quelque chose de pourri au royaume d'Amakna, Dofus pour les noobs) (1424): «¿Qué puedes contarme del edicto de Vhelika?» (63957) gets why he signed, pushed by Amayiro (48043), «Seguir escuchando.» (63956) the law calling to arms against a Brakmarian invasion (48044) and «Hasta luego.» (63955) is 7907. «Quien niega el último, niega mejor» (1477), for whoever refused Lalat's kamas: «Explicarle que ciertos habitantes de Bonta son víctimas del tráfico de esclavos.» -- he will have judge Satirev Novini look into it, and a reward for the trouble (48045) --, «Embolsarte la recompensa.» does 8279 (Dofus pour les noobs, «Niera bien qui niera le dernier»).

Captain Tymo napping in the militia's dormitories [-32,-57]: Dofus pour les noobs, «Le pacte des profondeurs», «Parlez alors au Capitaine», who lets you take a crate of weapons from the store across the corridor (18451).

Tymo at the meeting point once the White Rat has gone: Dofus pour les noobs, «Le pacte des profondeurs», «parlez au Capitaine qui vous a suivi jusqu'ici car il a été chargé de vous éliminer»; «Prepararte para el combate» is the fight against him and two corrupt militia (content/fights/npc_fights.json).

The White Rat at the meeting point of the sewers [-33,-57]: Dofus pour les noobs, «Le pacte des profondeurs», «pénétrez dans les égouts en [-33,-57] pour rencontrer le Rat Blanc et lui remettre l'armement» (18453, the crate 26228 taken). «Après que le Rat Blanc soit partit», Tymo steps in and speaks.

The Bontarian in distress of the sewers [-32,-58], robbed by two bandits: Dofus pour les noobs, «La Geste de Ratagnan», «Sur le point de le sauver, un héros avec un heaume fait son apparition et intervient avant vous»: D'Arratagnan speaks next. Level 90, the quest's PL>89.

D'Arratagnan in the sewers [-32,-58]: Dofus pour les noobs, «La Geste de Ratagnan», he sends the Bontarian away, charges the bandits and gets beaten; «Lever les yeux au ciel et se préparer à combattre» on his line 50175 (the step's own dialogue) starts the quest and the fight beside him (content/fights/npc_fights.json). Won (18420), he praises you, talks of the White Rat and runs west to her Pantry (18421).
D'Arratagnan waiting at the White Rat's Pantry [-34,-59]: «D'Arratagnan te esperará en la entrada».

Raccooper after his fight, in the Sylvan Refuge's last room: «This fight ends here. I won't risk standing up to you any longer.», then «Leave the Sylvan Refuge.» (content/world/dungeon_exits.json) or «Stay.».
Lee O'Summerly in «Kharnotaurus's Lair - Exit»: «By my godfathers! What a mess you've made inside!», then «Leave Kharnotaurus's Lair.» (content/world/dungeon_exits.json).

Kickroach in «Kickroach's Lair - Exit»: «I don't know how you got in here, but you're not welcome!» (19687), then «Leave Kickroach's Lair.» (content/world/dungeon_exits.json) or «Shrug your shoulders and end the conversation.». For «Miniature Adventure» (1607): «Ask about the magic croquette.» (23579) -> 19688 (he plays dumb), «Threaten to rinse Kerub's house clean away.» (23578) -> 19690, «Reply that you'll go and find a bucket and a mop...» (23577) -> 19691, «Ask about the croquette again.» (23576) -> 19692 (an Ecaflip hired them), «Ask who this Ecaflip is.» (23575) -> 19693, «Say that you'd be interested in meeting this person.» (23574) -> 19694 (the grocery store in Astrub), «Take the croquette, then go and see Kerub to find out more.» (23573) does 9394. Dofus pour les noobs («Aventure miniature»).

The White Rat in her Pantry's last room once beaten (18422): «Salir de la mazmorra» takes you back to its door [-34,-59]; Dofus pour les noobs, «La Geste de Ratagnan», «Lui demander des informations sur son art du combat», then D'Arratagnan has his say and «Écouter Ratagnan demander confirmation au Rat Blanc»: she sends him to the surface with you (18438) and he follows you from then on (the follower 26202). The two hidden items of the quest (26207, 26208) mark who has spoken.

D'Arratagnan in the Pantry's last room, amazed the White Rat lost: Dofus pour les noobs, «La Geste de Ratagnan», «Parlez à Ratagnan étonné d'avoir assisté à la défaite du Rat Blanc», who will not hear of the surface and goes to ask her himself. Lost in a fight before the library, he comes back here («Volver a la biblioteca»).

Vayinklán in Bonta's library [-35,-57]: Dofus pour les noobs, «La Geste de Ratagnan», «Parlez à Marcelle Rouste pour en apprendre plus sur l'art de l'escrime bontarienne», the good blades, the year 290 and the heirs on the Promontory of the Skies (18423). Without D'Arratagnan beside you, «Darte cuenta de que D'Arratagnan no está contigo». And «El hijo pródigo»: «Pedir el libro sobre la infancia de Gúltar» (63989) closes «Ve a visitar la biblioteca de una de las grandes ciudades» and «Habla con el bibliotecario»; his 49090 says Gracia Malsana borrowed it, «¿Dónde está?» (65547) gets 49091 (upstairs), and «Darle las gracias al bibliotecario» (65546) starts «No dejes que tus hijos vaguen» (527), whose giver he is in the catalogue. «Le livre des Taures», Bonta's library [-35,-57] («Parlez à Marcelle Rouste ... celle-ci n'a pas ce livre et de plus n'a aucune idée d'où vous pourriez en trouver un»): 63999, 48069, 63998, 48070, and «Adiós» (63997) is objective 8650.

Faramis on the Promontory of the Skies [-36,-59]: Dofus pour les noobs, «La Geste de Ratagnan», the cousin of intendant Danathor, a good blade; a rat has no noble blood, but he tells the other way only after a duel, and takes you somewhere fitter for it (18425). «Volver a la sala de duelo» if you left it first.

Faramis in the palace's training room: Dofus pour les noobs, «La Geste de Ratagnan», «Vous êtes téléporté dans un dojo, reparlez à Faramis « Affronter Faramis »», alone (content/fights/npc_fights.json, 18426); then a rat can become a good blade by serving one noble person. «Salir de la sala» and «Ir a buscar a otro noble» take you back to the promontory. INFERRED room: 222560266, the palace's one closed training hall [-36,-60] no door leads to («Ya tengo un aprendiz en el palacio»).

Hemmy Lady by the fountain [-35,-59], who lost her miaumiau: Dofus pour les noobs, «La Geste de Ratagnan», D'Arratagnan promises to find Nieve, «Reparlez à Ratagnan pour qu'il vous suive» (18427); back with the cat found, she takes him as her own good blade and the quest ends (18428).
D'Arratagnan beside Hemmy Lady: «Vamos a ir en busca de Nieve, ¿no?» and he follows you again; out of breath once Nieve has chased him back here, and her good blade for good after the quest.

Nieve, Hemmy Lady's white miaumiau, among the shiny things of the slums [-33,-55]: Dofus pour les noobs, «La Geste de Ratagnan», «Laisser faire Ratagnan», the cat goes for the rat and chases him north, back to the fountain. «Buscar algo para hacer un cebo» after a scratch ends the same way.
Nieve back with Hemmy Lady by the fountain.

D'Arratagnan follows for one fight only (the follower's 811 is 1), so the duel, fought alone, leaves him behind, and so does any other fight on the way. «D'Arratagnan te había perdido de vista así que ha vuelto al último sitio donde se había cruzado contigo»: lost after the library, he waits there and «Ir a buscar un heredero de los buenos espadas» takes him along again.

D'Arratagnan follows for one fight only (the follower's 811 is 1), so the duel, fought alone, leaves him behind, and so does any other fight on the way. «D'Arratagnan te había perdido de vista así que ha vuelto al último sitio donde se había cruzado contigo»: after the duel he waits on the promontory, and «Ir a buscar un noble» takes him to Hemmy Lady with you.

Chemdilth Chab in the malady ward of Brakmar's sewers [-25,39], sworn to keep her patients ill: Dofus pour les noobs, «Déficience immunitaire», «Faire craquer ses doigts et se mettre au travail» hires you (2435); the report on the too healthy rat sends you to Ratusalén (18367), the first symptoms earn a letter for him (18375) and the rat ill at last ends it (18379), her care free for you from then on.

Ratusalén, the old rat by his friend the garden gnome [-27,35]: Dofus pour les noobs, «Déficience immunitaire», he sends Chemdilth's helper off until a duel, alone («Le prendre au mot et l'attaquer», 18369), then reveals Brakmar's foul air; with her letter he praises her and gives the recipe of Elfi's stew (18376). «Usar la violencia» if you walked away from the duel.

The lively rataplastada on its bed in the malady ward: Dofus pour les noobs, «Déficience immunitaire», its health tested in a fight, alone (18366); «Llevarla a tomar un soplo de aire fétido» once Ratusalén has spoken and it follows you (26135); Elfi's stew makes it ill and a second fight checks it (18377, 18378). It follows for one fight only: lost on the way, it is back on its bed.

The rataplastada before Brakmar's militia [-25,33]: Dofus pour les noobs, «Déficience immunitaire», «un peu plus fatigué mais globalement toujours en… forme»; then on to the Gatokemao tavern with you (18371). Lost on the way there, it waits here.
The rataplastada in the Gatokemao tavern [-28,38]: Dofus pour les noobs, «Déficience immunitaire», a sore throat at last, and back to the malady ward with you (18373). Lost on the way, it waits here.

Temerius before the passage to Brakmar's mine [-23,38]: Dofus pour les noobs, «La lumière au bout des égouts», the mine is haunted, he says, and «Aceptar el desafío» sends you to find out (2436); a lost miaumiausita, not ghosts, and he is allergic: a shard of the green ore will lure her out (18412), and the single-use pickaxe shown he tells how to use it (18413); the cat gone, he can watch the lights again (18418).

The lost miaumiausita that comes out of the crate of roguish bombs [-22,37]: Dofus pour les noobs, «La lumière au bout des égouts», «Tenter de caresser la chachatonne», afraid of the rats around (18419); twenty tufts of Brakmar rat show her they do not scare you, and she heads east (18409).

The miaumiausita before the green ore [-21,37]: Dofus pour les noobs, «La lumière au bout des égouts», she ignores you whatever you try, «Abandonner et retourner voir Dras Fours pour parler de cet étrange minerai» (18411).
The miaumiausita following the shard's beam of light up the sewers [-21,36].
The miaumiausita out of the sewers in Brakmar's streets [-21,36]: Dofus pour les noobs, «La lumière au bout des égouts», shown the shard she snatches it and runs off into the dark streets (18417).

Captain Starky at Bonta's militia [-32,-57], the Bontarians' daily dragoturkey charge (144, Dofus pour les noobs, «Chargez !»): to a Bontarian who may take it, «Para lanzarnos contra los brakmarianos con mi caballería, necesito monturas...» with «Te prometo que te traeré un animal conforme a tus necesidades» (the guide's «Promettre de lui fournir un animal correspondant à ses besoins») or the infantry; with it running, his charge line and «Te confío el dragopavo» once a red dragoturkey is carried, which he pays with breeder's scrolls (49098), or the promise to bring one. The client's texts follow one another in that order (941394-941400). For «L'amour perdu de Nabur» (Dofus pour les noobs, «L'amour perdu de Nabur»: «parlez au Captain Starky et demandez lui si il a lui vu le Dark Vlad afin de finir la quête»): Dark Vlad came by a few days ago and left the militia with disorder and desecrations (49093). For «Naissance d'une vocation» (Dofus pour les noobs, «Naissance d'une vocation»): the desecrations (49093, «¿Las profanaciones?»), insults painted on the militia's Iop statue by someone who hates Dark Vlad (49094, «Voy a investigar el asunto.» starts it); shown the compromising document, he knows the Giasau seal, breeders for generations (49095), and sends the character to Giasau (49096).

Aplastator el Aminal in Brakmar [-26,35], the Brakmarians' daily dragoturkey charge (145, Brakmar's twin of Dofus pour les noobs, «Chargez !»): to a Brakmarian who may take it, «Busco dragopavos masivos y violentos...» (the step's own line) with the promise or the infantry; with it running «¡¡¡QUIERO PARTICIPAR!!!», the red dragoturkey taken on a hello like the old quests' hand-overs (he has no reply to give it with), then his thanks and scrolls until the next day; else his charge line. His lines for 252 and 278 are not written: their objectives on him are done on a hello.

Captain Amakna on the village square, «Proteger y servir» (Protéger et sévir, Dofus pour les noobs): «La quête se lance en [0,0] auprès du Captain Amakna», daily (repeatType 1), from level 10 (PL>9). «¿Quién eres tú?» (16222). The first time «¿No necesitas ayuda?» (16223) tells of the criminals grown in number while he chased Sylargh, the recruiting of super-assistants (16224), and «Acepto.» starts it (16225). «Los bandidos han salido corriendo.» once the three are beaten ends it (7904, 16227: «¡Has aprobado el examen!»). On later days «Estoy dispuesto a devolver el orden al pueblo de Amakna.» starts it again (16228) and the same report ends it (16229). The client also holds a second copy of the recruiting lines (16524-16526, replies 19677-19681) with the same words; the first is used. «¡Huele a podrido en el reino de Amakna!» (Quelque chose de pourri au royaume d'Amakna, Dofus pour les noobs) (1424, level 80 after «Proteger y servir»): «Hablemos sobre el reino de Amakna.» (19297) gets the alliances that please him but something that does not fit (16261), «Hacerle preguntas para averiguar más cosas.» (19296) the king's councillor Makia Vhelika, who hides something (16262), «¿Quieres que haga una investigación?» (19294) his trust (16263) and «Voy a ir al castillo.» (19293) starts it; «Hasta luego.» (19295) leaves. «¡Mira! La cabeza de la marioneta.» (19326) shows the head (7918, kept) and ends it: the symbol (16278), «Informarle de tus descubrimientos.» (19325) the headache (16279), «¿De quién hablas?» (19324) Dramak the Plotter (16280), «¿Qué piensas hacer para remediar la situación?» (19323) the plan (16281), where «Acepto la misión.» (19328) starts «Como una marioneta» (1425, 16282, «Voy en busca de Dramak.» 19327) and the doctor's excuse (19329) leaves. Declined then, «¿Qué cuentas hacer a propósito de Dramak?» (19333) offers it again with the second copy of those lines (16283-16284, 19330-19332). «Como una marioneta» (Ainsi font les petites marionnettes, Dofus pour les noobs): «Annoncez lui alors votre victoire contre Dramak». «He vencido a Dramak.» (19336), once Dramak has been talked to (7922), gets his congratulations and the promise of his shield (16285), «Aprender el arte de blandir el escudo.» (19335) is 7923 and ends the quest with the attitude, and he congratulates again (16286). «Ejército de las sombras» (L'armée des ombres, Dofus pour les noobs): «Dîtes alors à celui-ci que vous êtes envoyé par Lumino afin de pénétrer la Dimension Obscure». «Lúmino me ha pedido que entre en la dimensión obscura.» (19671) gets his laugh and Sombra freed by Sylargh (16516), «Seguir escuchando.» (19670) the ice gallery and the five multimen (16517), «Seguir escuchando.» (19669) Bowis and the freed brothers (16518), «¿Qué puedes contarme sobre la leyenda?» (19668) the cobbler who knows it better (16519), and «Tranquilo, tendré mucho cuidado. Ahora voy a ver a Bowis.» (19667) is 8084. «Pollution, je dis non» (Dofus pour les noobs): «Parlez au Captain Amakna et demandez lui ce qui le préoccupe». «Capitán, pareces preocupado.» (19549, level 180 and «Como una marioneta» done) gets the sick fishers (16412), «Seguir escuchando.» (19548) the heavy technomagic oil (16413), «Probablemente se trata de una contaminación accidental.» (19547) Buuky's word on Merkator (16414), «¿Quién es Merkator?» (19546) the mad cartographer (16415), «También puedes contar conmigo.» (19545) his request (16416), «Dime lo que necesitas.» (19543) the source to find (16417), «Hmm... Quizás los steamers puedan localizar el lugar exacto.» (19542) the steamer diver of Astrub (16418), and «Voy a Astrub.» (19541) starts the quest. Back with the cleaner handed over (8004), «He arreglado el problema de contaminación del río.» (19611) gets 16465, «Solo he hecho lo que tenía que hacer.» (19610) the hammer head (16466) and «Gracias. Hasta luego.» (19609) ends it (8005). The template's replies, each to the message of its rank.

Cuerbax in the classroom of the Justiciers' base, by «Stage de combat improvisé» (Dofus pour les noobs) and his own lines. Once «Proteger y servir» and «Escuela de superhéroes» are done (the catalogue's QF>1423,0&QF>1445,0), «Pedir más información» brings the offer (16559) and «Aceptar.» starts «Prácticas en combate improvisado» (16560: «si el recluta pierde el conocimiento durante el combate, se anulará la evaluación»). «Quiero evaluar a un recluta.» lists the pairings the quest still has to do («Al recluta explosivo contra los Gumbre»…); a prisoner already captured gives «El combate en grupo…» and «Ir a la sala de combate», the room of the quest's own objective, else «Para hacerlo, tienes que capturar primero a…». «¿Cómo han ido las evaluaciones?» is the report once every fight is won (16570, 16593, 16606, 16624, 16654) with the next quest's «Aceptar.», or «Estoy desbordado…» before. The next quest can also be taken later («Aceptar la proposición anterior»). «Quiero ayudar a un amigo…» (16655) takes the character to a captured prisoner's room. The step dialogs of the catalogue are the lines after each acceptance (16560, 16571, 16594, 16607, 16625); the second «No voy a volver a explicarte…» of each quest is its opening while in hand.

Its evaluation line, then «¿Listo para enfrentarte a…?» for each evaluation of the quest in hand that is fought here, its answer and «Luchar contra…»; its «no veo a nuestro adversario» when the prisoner has not been captured.
